full_judgment: 12. Further case of the defendants is that the plaintiff having been in charge of looking after the entire land in absence of the defendant No.1 got the suit land recorded in his name in the recent BRS record. The defendant No.2 opened separate Khatian in respect of 0.041/2 acre of the suit land and has been paying rent. Plaintiff had been holding out threats to the tenants of the defendant which led to making a GD entry by the tenant. The plaintiff has never had the quantum of land close to the statutory ceiling nor was he ever a tax payer. There is only one mango tree standing on the suit land which did not bear mango worth more than Tk. 30 or 40 and the tenant of the defendants neither did nor had any reason to steal the mango.
